record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ICICLE_MISSILE: Vanilluxe (3 stars), Vanillish (2 stars), Vanillite (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Picks the first 1/2/3 (by stars; 5 as fallback) enemy units after sorting all enemies by board row, then 1000 ms later hits each of them (if a live enemy still stands on the remembered cell) with an attempted 2000 ms freeze followed by 50 raw SPECIAL damage. The freeze is attempted before the damage and has no probability roll.

targeting.who: all enemy-team units on the board, ordered by row (rows read via board.forEach, then sorted by positionY: ascending when the enemies are the BLUE team, descending when they are the RED team; the sort is stable so equal rows keep forEach order, y then x); the first `count` are selected, one missile each. The cast target is not used.
targeting.note: The cast target is not used, so the ability fires without a target in range (requiresTarget false). The selection records the cell at cast time. At execution time the unit standing on that cell (possibly a different one if units moved) is hit if it has hp > 0 and is on the other team; if the original unit moved away and nobody else stands there, that missile does nothing. If the caster dies before the delay, whether its queued commands still run was not examined.

geometry.shape: no area; up to `count` single cells chosen from the enemy units' rows, independent of the caster's position and range

effects.target: the unit on each selected cell 1000 ms after the cast, if alive and an enemy

declaredRaw.label: requested damage (raw), same for every star level

effects.scaling: requested = 50 per missile, not scaled by stars (stars only change the missile count 1/2/3). handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the hit unit) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT. The same crit flag from the cast applies to every missile. Several missiles may land on one unit only if it occupies several selected cells, which cannot happen (one unit, one cell).
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. See knowledge/07367c34/core-mechanics.md section A.

statusEffects.target: the unit hit by each missile

declaredRaw.label: requested base duration; attempted on every hit, no chance roll

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit; no luck roll.
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the unit's status is not already frozen, has no rune protect or skydiving, and its ccCooldown is 0. Because the call is `entityHit.status.triggerFreeze(2000, tg, pokemon)`, the immunity check, weather (SNOW x1.3, DROUGHT x0.7), enraged halving and duration reductions are evaluated against `tg`, the unit originally selected at cast time (the second argument), not against entityHit when that is a different unit; only the freeze/runeProtect/skydiving/ccCooldown checks read the frozen unit. Freeze then lasts Math.round(duration) and wears off faster if the unit is also burning. The freeze call comes before the damage call, so the damage resolves against an already frozen unit.

starBehavior.note: Stars only change the number of missiles (1/2/3/(5 for 4 stars and as the ?? fallback)); the 4-star count 5 is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Damage and freeze do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Selection is by board row only: enemies in the rows farthest toward the enemy side of the sorted order come first; the caster's position and range play no part. If fewer enemies than `count` exist, only that many missiles are fired.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and queues new delayed commands, so casts closer than 1000 ms apart overlap; a unit already frozen is not re-frozen and the freeze timer is not extended, and a unit that just ended a freeze has a crowd-control cooldown (ccCooldown) that blocks a new freeze (the damage still lands).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 50 raw SPECIAL damage per missile, 1/2/3 missiles (1/2/3 stars), freeze 2000 ms on every hit. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 for protected units. Applied freeze duration depends on weather, the enraged state, duration reductions of the originally selected unit, and is 0 (not applied) if the hit unit is already frozen, protected or in its crowd-control cooldown. Big Eater Belt and Twist Band only change the caster's own stat changes and do not touch this.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
